navaid.name: U.S. Coast Guard - Station Scituate
navaid.description: Operating seasonally, U.S. Coast Guard Station Scituate's primary duties, include search and rescue, enforcement of laws and treaties, military readiness, marine environmental protection and recreational boating safety.
